By CRT:
\[
2^{2015}\equiv 0 \pmod 4,\quad 2^{2015}\equiv 2 \pmod 3,\quad 2^{2015}\equiv 18 \pmod{25}.
\]
Solving gives
\[
2^{2015}\equiv 68 \pmod{300}.
\]
Thus
\[
S=\frac{2^{2015}-3023}{3}\equiv \frac{68-3023}{3}\equiv \frac{68-23}{3}=15 \pmod{100}.
\]
Therefore the last two digits are
\[
\boxed{15}
\]
